GPT-6 Astra is here. I put it next to Claude Fable 5.1 on the same prompts: a one-shot museum landing page, a Zillow-to-Blender property tour, a GameCube-style drone race from a Google Earth screenshot, a Three.js jelly, Pinterest UI motion, and a Diffusion Studio video recreate.

Join CreatorNTWRK 👇
https://discord.com/invite/vZxn6wZrDD
https://www.skool.com/builderzgym

What we cover:
- What’s showing up on X with Astra (games, Blender office, real-world tasks)
- Same landing page prompt in Claude Code (Fable 5.1) vs Codex (GPT-6)
- Side-by-side design critique (logo, typography habits, sticky scroll, buttons)
- Zillow listing → Blender model → camera tour (GPT-6 vs Fable recreation)
- Google Earth + red-line track → GameCube Sonic-style drone race
- Delicious bouncy jelly in Three.js + WebGPU (both models)
- Recreate a Pinterest card scroll motion one-shot
- Diffusion Studio: recreate the reference video with Fable 5.1 vs GPT-6
